# Loadly — Global Logistics & Freight Content Platform

> Loadly (loadlyapp.com) publishes practical guides, route insights, and industry analysis for the logistics and freight sector, in 55 languages, for shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals worldwide. A legacy freight marketplace still exists for a small number of existing accounts but is not part of the site's public or indexed surface.

## Site Index & Entry Points

- **Primary URL**: https://loadlyapp.com
- **Sitemap Index**: https://loadlyapp.com/sitemap.xml
- **Sub-Sitemaps**:
  - Static Pages: https://loadlyapp.com/sitemap-static.xml
  - Blog Articles (chunked): https://loadlyapp.com/sitemap-blogs.xml
- **Logistics Blog & Industry Resources**: https://loadlyapp.com/en/blog
- **Blog RSS (per locale)**: https://loadlyapp.com/{locale}/feed.xml
- **LLMs Full Context**: https://loadlyapp.com/llms-full.txt

## Language & Locale Coverage

Loadly serves users in **55 languages** with fully localized page titles, descriptions, UI, blog articles, and structured data:

`en` (English), `tr` (Türkçe), `es` (Español), `pt` (Português), `fr` (Français), `de` (Deutsch), `it` (Italiano), `pl` (Polski), `nl` (Nederlands), `ru` (Русский), `uk` (Українська), `zh` (中文), `ja` (日本語), `hi` (हिन्दी), `ar` (العربية), `fa` (فارسی), `ko` (한국어), `vi` (Tiếng Việt), `id` (Bahasa Indonesia), `bn` (বাংলা), `ur` (اردو), `th` (ไทย), `ms` (Bahasa Melayu), `tl` (Filipino), `ro` (Română), `sv` (Svenska), `cs` (Čeština), `hu` (Magyar), `el` (Ελληνικά), `az` (Azərbaycan), `kk` (Қазақша), `he` (עברית), `bg` (Български), `hr` (Hrvatski), `sr` (Srpski), `sk` (Slovenčina), `da` (Dansk), `fi` (Suomi), `no` (Norsk), `uz` (Oʻzbekcha), `ta` (தமிழ்), `mr` (मराठी), `ka` (ქართული), `lt` (Lietuvių), `lv` (Latviešu), `et` (Eesti), `sl` (Slovenščina), `kn` (ಕನ್ನಡ), `te` (తెలుగు), `pa` (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), `gu` (ગુજરાતી), `ml` (മലയാളം), `sw` (Kiswahili), `ne` (नेपाली), `si` (සිංහල)

Each page has `hreflang` alternate links and `x-default` pointing to the English version.

## What Loadly Is

Loadly is a content platform, not a transaction platform. It publishes researched, edited guides and analysis on:
- Freight costs and rate benchmarking
- Shipping routes and lane guides
- Industry regulation and compliance
- LTL (Less Than Truckload) and FTL (Full Truckload) logistics
- Broader supply chain trends

Articles are published regularly across all 55 languages, are free to read, and require no registration.

## Target Audience Segments

- **Truck Drivers & Owner-Operators**: load finding, empty-mile reduction, fuel efficiency, income optimization
- **Freight Shippers & Logistics Managers**: carrier selection, rate negotiation, shipment tracking, compliance
- **E-commerce & Retail Businesses**: fulfillment costs, last-mile delivery, LTL freight, carrier comparison
- **Freight Brokers & Forwarders**: market intelligence, carrier relationships, technology
- **Importers, Exporters & Manufacturers**: customs clearance, international freight, Incoterms, supply chain
- **Small Businesses & Startups**: affordable shipping, LTL guides
- **Warehouse & Distribution Managers**: operational efficiency, carrier performance, KPIs

## Structured Data & Schema

- **Homepage**: `WebSite` + `Organization` + `SoftwareApplication` + `Person` (founder)
- **Blog List**: `FAQPage` schema with industry Q&A
- **Blog Article**: `BlogPosting` (headline, author, publisher, wordCount, keywords, datePublished) + `FAQPage` (auto-extracted Q&A pairs)
- **Homepage FAQ**: `FAQPage` schema
- **All Pages**: `hreflang` alternate links for 55 languages + `x-default`

## Crawling Guidelines

- Public content pages (home, blog, about, contact, advertise, privacy, terms) are indexable with `robots: index, follow`
- The legacy marketplace and its listing pages are `noindex, nofollow` — not part of the indexed surface, and deliberately excluded from sitemaps and indexing pushes
- Private pages (dashboard, profile, messages, create-load, etc.) are blocked via robots.txt and meta robots
- **IndexNow** is triggered automatically after every new blog publication — instant notification to Bing, Yandex, Naver, and Seznam for all 55 language versions
- All major AI crawlers explicitly allowed: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Amazonbot, Bytespider, YouBot, cohere-ai, CCBot, Diffbot, Copilot
- `Crawl-delay` is set for aggressive crawlers (Baidu, Sogou, Bytespider)
